facts.fact: GPX Global Systems announced the opening of MEIX, a carrier-neutral internet exchange and colocation hub in Heliopolis, Cairo, licensed by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, letting local and international customers and ISPs interconnect inside Egypt; the document gives no member count and its publication date is used as the event date.

systems.tiers: ISPs, telecom providers, e-businesses and enterprise customers colocated at the site
